answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests over a long horizon before it can earn: a new identity deposits 500 POA, released only after 30 days of verified work. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 500,000 POA for a month, while honest agents get theirs back. Each fake identity is an ember that costs real capital to light, and a comet of cheap aliases burns out against the same wall: the attack scales only by paying linearly more, which destroys its profit.
